name: Tinker: Strength Bionics 510176 is a buff, not a debuff (COA-4688)
contract: Strength Bionics is the Tinker's party buff paired with Arcane Bionics 541493. Its damage-taken effect made the aura count as negative, so it showed among the debuffs. Like Arcane Bionics, it is applied as a positive aura.

steps.label: SETUP: Strength Bionics is on the target
Strength Bionics is applied as a buff
Arcane Bionics stays a buff too
